title: Fit and pin a hinged collar around a captive shaft
instruction: Open the hinged collar, fit it around the shaft between its fixed end stops, close both halves with the shaft rib in the upper groove, and insert the orange-headed key through all three aligned lugs. Leave the collar retained with both hands clear.
context: A collar cannot slide over the shaft's fixed flanges. The robot must open its hinge, support both halves around the captive shaft, close the seam and insert a transverse key through three lugs. This replaces generic kitting.
setup: Bimanual YAM station; x forward, y left, z up; metres/kg/radians; XYZW quaternions. Tabletop z=0.7475 m. Fixed layout, seed 0, no object jitter. Each object below is an authored rigid body or cable-chain link; dimensions are collision envelopes. Shapes, local offsets, colors and joints are fully enumerated in scene.json. captive_shaft: rigid material, 1.2 kg, envelope (0.052, 0.25, 0.101) m, origin (0.33, 0, 0.8225), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). lower_collar: rigid material, 0.12 kg, envelope (0.119, 0.186, 0.038065) m, origin (0.185, 0, 0.7717), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). upper_collar: rigid material, 0.1 kg, envelope (0.104065, 0.189, 0.051) m, origin (0.185, 0, 0.7717), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). collar_key: rigid material, 0.025 kg, envelope (0.022, 0.093, 0.022) m, origin (0.36, -0.24, 0.7587), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). A longitudinal 3 mm wide shaft rib engages the groove in the upper collar. Upper handle local center (0.07,-0.16,0.025) m, with a 0.16-m support bar. Full collision geometry is in scene.json.
scoring: 0.25 for lower_half_located; 0.25 for collar_closed; 0.5 for collar_retained. Each goal requires all numeric predicates in SCORING.md and scene.json. Credit is recomputed, so dislodged components lose credit. Full score also requires all bodies <=0.01 m/s and <=0.2 rad/s, robot clearance >=0.02 m, continuously for 2.0 s; otherwise score is capped at 0.95. Invalid frames, lost parts, fixture motion, broken preservation constraints, joint-limit violations or penetration >0.002 m permanently score zero.
run_limit: 6000 control actions at 20 Hz (300 simulated seconds maximum)
reset_notes: Native reset restores the authored layout and zero joint coordinates, settles through the official adapter, clears scorer history, and records a new episode. Native probes compare two reset repetitions within 3 mm. Seed 0; object_jitter=0.
fidelity: Rigid faceted half-rings and a passive hinge model a service collar. Fixed end flanges prevent axial assembly; a free square key captures three interleaved lugs. Extended handles suit YAM jaws. The task tests assembly and retention, not certified clamping friction or torque transmission.
scores: NOT RUN: native physics, expert demonstrations and Dream-1 evaluation have not been executed.
